artifacts.summary: Implementation summary: two modules ported, wired, pinned and gated; all acceptance criteria met.

The translation product proof device: prodRel transfers, FrameOver.translationProduct, history lifting, three truth invariances, three *ValidIn_iff_recurrenceFree theorems, frame_validity_not_reflected, translationProductProj.
Coarse-model lifting to the product: liftK, c_invariance, pasteClosed_liftK, pasteClosed_of_liftK, c_refuted_lift.

completion_data.completion_summary: Ported the translation-product proof device from the research probe into two library modules (Semantics/Frames/TranslationProduct.lean, Metalogic/Independence/TranslationProductCoarse.lean) with no sorry and no new axiom; wired aggregators, READMEs, generated root and inventory, theorem-index rows and C14 pins. Full lake build --wfail green, check-module-invariants.sh all checks pass, mk_all --check exit 0, the three *ValidIn_iff_recurrenceFree theorems at standard axioms.

memory_candidates.content: A probe compiled with `lake env lean` can still fail `lake build --wfail` when ported: the package's `weak.linter.mathlibStandardSet` turns on `linter.style.show` (goal-changing `show` must become `change`) and `linter.style.longLine` (100 columns, docstrings included). Run the scoped guarded build before assuming a probe's zero-warning status carries over.

Module-adding checklist for FormalSystem: aggregator import + bullet, Semantics.lean/Independence.lean docstring bullet, directory README key-definitions bullet and generated-block description, `lake exe mk_all --lib FormalSystem`, `check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory` LAST (re-run if any .lean line count changes afterwards, else INV fails), theorem-index rows with `Paper: —` at the declaration, C14BASE + C14LEAN heredoc lines in the same order.

reflection.what_worked: Transcribing the compiled probe verbatim with only renames and docstring rewrites; scoped guarded builds per phase caught the two linter classes cheaply before the full build.
reflection.what_was_hard: The tree's linter set differs from what `lake env lean` applied to the probe (show/change, 100-column lines), and `--emit-inventory` must be the last step after every line-count-changing edit.
reflection.what_was_missed: The first full --wfail build failed on a 101-column docstring line I had just added; a line-length awk over touched .lean files before the full build would have avoided one rebuild. A Python slice on the plan file matched an inline mention of a heading and duplicated a region; restored from HEAD.
reflection.successes: Both modules green under --wfail, 49/49 invariant checks pass, three flagship theorems pinned at [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].
